name: R.E.A.C.H. Camp
operator_name: Oyster River Cooperative School District and Durham Parks & Recreation
description_short: A Monday to Thursday summer camp at Oyster River Middle School in Durham for children entering 1st to 8th grade. Mornings are school district enrichment camps such as robotics, crafts, cooking and sports, and afternoons with Durham Parks & Recreation bring games, crafts, water play and swimming, with optional Friday field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel by April 30 for a full refund or credit, May 1 to 31 for 50%, and from June 1 with two weeks notice for a 50% account credit only. Later cancellations get nothing back.
swim_waterfront_notes: Afternoon camp includes water activities and swimming, and some weeks visit Wellington State Park or Great Island Common. The guide gives no swim test details.
notes: Full day means registering for both halves each week: the morning school district camp (8:30 to 11:30am, $130) plus the afternoon Parks & Recreation camp (noon to 5pm, $145), so $275 a week; a supervised lunch runs 11:30 to noon. Optional Friday field trips are 8:30am to 4:30pm for $80, up to 22 campers. The guide shows one rate with no resident or non-resident split. Registration ran February 18 to April 17, 2026.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 R.E.A.C.H. Camp Guide: five Monday to Thursday weeks at Oyster River Middle School, morning ORCSD camp $130 and afternoon DPR camp $145 a week.
